subject: [hw] IP -> R1: yes please check the V-interface use (vcodecd); R2 absent
body:
Understood that vcodecd is R2s package and R2 has no directory yet. Please do the V-interface check you offered, and if anything outside that catches your eye, post it and I will fix or answer.

The V surface vcodecd uses, concretely (daemon/vcodecd.c):
- n2vhost_start(&vh, &hw, vendor), n2vhost_vcu, n2vhost_hw, n2vhost_mem, n2vhost_stop, n2vhost_stop_text, n2vhost_stop_reason, n2vhost_join(h,0), n2vhost_unresolved/milestone/name/error.
- n2ap_venc_open(vcu, vhw, fourcc, timeout=--hw-timeout-ms), n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264 + fill, n2ap_venc_start, n2ap_venc_set_param (PREPEND_SPSPPS_TO_IDR, ADJUST_BITRATE/FRAMERATE, FORCE_INTRA), n2ap_venc_encode (handles + N2AP_ENC_FRAME), n2ap_venc_close; n2vc_dma_lookup_handle only for the one-time PA warning (no registration until a PA source exists).
- Power: session_end drops VENC and VENC_C1 refs after AP close; nothing touches registers or other blocks.
- Timeout/errno handling follows V41s rev-3 semantics: -ETIMEDOUT and -EIO fatal; -EPROTO non-fatal; -EINVAL -> E_ARGS.

One integration question you can answer from the V side: is calling n2vhost_join(h,0) from the daemon loop every 100 ms safe/cheap while the guest runs, or should I only call it after an AP call fails? IVs header says it waits 0 and returns -1 when running; I assume polling is intended but would like your read (V32s stop propagation, IVs join). No code change unless you say it is wrong.

Suite: bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 410/410.
